summary: Iter 6: Validated NEW features — hand history (POST/GET/DELETE /api/hands) and confidence flags on /api/recognize-cards & /api/scan-frame. 11/11 backend pytest tests pass. Frontend E2E via Playwright: route-intercepted recognize-cards to inject low/medium confidence, verified flagged-notice count, data-flagged attributes on card-trigger-2 and card-trigger-4, flag clearing after manual pick, history creation on upload, history-item click reloads hand+rescores, clear-history-btn empties list, manual entry does NOT create history, no share-btn, no horizontal overflow @390px.

backend_hands_api.POST /api/hands green band (total>=7): PASS — A-S K-S 2-H 3-H returned band='green', all required fields present
backend_hands_api.POST /api/hands gold band (4<=total<=6): PASS — A-S 2-H 5-C K-D returned band='gold', source='upload' preserved
backend_hands_api.GET /api/hands newest-first + no _id lea: PASS — timestamps descending, no MongoDB _id in response

backend_confidence_flags.recognize-cards: PASS — real vision model returned 4 cards each with confidence in {high,medium,low}
backend_confidence_flags.scan-frame: PASS — every card has valid confidence

frontend_confidence_flag_ui.route interception injects low/medium: flagged-notice reads '2 cards the scanner wasn\'t sure about — tap to verify' ✓
frontend_confidence_flag_ui.manual pick clears flag: picking rank K + suit H on card 2 set data-flagged=false and flagged-notice dropped to '1 card' ✓

frontend_history_ui.upload creates history entry: 1 item after set_input_files upload ✓ (via real recognize endpoint)
frontend_history_ui.manual entry does NOT log: manual setting of 3 cards (Q-S, J-H, 9-D) kept history count at 1; logHand is only called from onScanDetected/processImage — verified by code + count assertion ✓

critical_code_review_comments: Backend correctly caps limit at 100 via max(1,min(limit,100)) and excludes _id via projection {'_id':0} — clean.
SaveHandRequest normalises source to 'camera' if not in whitelist — good defensive default.
_band mapping matches spec exactly (<=3 red, <=6 gold, else green).
_parse_cards_json defaults confidence to 'high' when missing or invalid — good defensive fallback that also protects UI from spurious flags.
CardSelector.pick() sets confidence:'high' on any manual pick — cleanly clears the flag as designed.
logHand is only invoked from processImage (upload) and onScanDetected (camera). updateCard/manual paths do NOT log, matching spec.
PlayingCard.jsx applies both amber ring (animate-pulse) and a '?' badge when flagged — accessible dual-signal.
Minor: /api/hands POST re-runs full evaluate on server (correct/secure); frontend does not blindly trust client totals.
Minor UX note (not a bug): flagged-notice uses 'card/cards' singular/plural correctly.
seed_data_creation: Test module wipes /api/hands at setup+teardown; test hands (green/gold/red) are created and cleaned within the module.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Hand history + confidence flag features are fully working end-to-end. During Playwright, once (only once) rank-4-6 popover open timed out after 3 manual cards were set — likely animation/focus race after repeated Escape presses; not a functional bug. If retesting, add a short wait_for_selector on card-popover-<i> after clicking card-trigger-<i>. All spec assertions in the request are validated. Backend tests are in /app/backend/tests/test_hands.py and reusable.
